findings.issue: Common noun מִנְחָה (H4503) is left as the untranslated lemma minjá; common nouns stay Spanish.
בַּמֶּלַח is preposition plus article plus salt (with the salt); con sal drops the definiteness.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens: salt the offering, do not cause covenant-salt of your God to cease from upon your grain offering, and bring salt near upon every offering of yours.
